title: 1" two-piece full-port ball valve
one_line: DN25 quarter-turn ball valve: hex body with screwed-in end piece, stainless ball between two PTFE seats, blow-out-proof stem with packing, lever with stop, driven 0-90 deg by one parameter.
specs: Two-piece: body + screwed-in end piece (insert), body seal
Female 1" NPT-style ends drawn as Ø30.4 mm minor bore + 6 stacked grooves at 2.209 mm (11.5 TPI) pitch + thread relief, 17 mm deep
Face to face 92 mm; hexes 46 mm A/F; barrel Ø62 mm
Ball Ø42 mm with Ø25 mm bore and 4.4 mm stem slot
Two PTFE seats, ID 27 / OD 40 mm, conical lip 0.16 mm off the ball
Stem Ø10 mm, 7 mm double-D flats, Ø16 mm blow-out-proof shoulder inside the body + PTFE thrust washer
Stem seal: 2 PTFE packing rings, gland follower, 26 mm A/F packing nut
Lever 125 mm from stem axis, vinyl grip, two stop tabs, 14 mm A/F handle nut, stop pin in body lug
Stop tabs sit 0.19 mm from the stop pin at 0 deg and at 90 deg (ryucad clearance)
parameters: valve (assembly ball-valve): stem revolute angle, 0 deg open .. 90 deg closed
interference: 32 pairs, 0 interferences (at valve=0 deg and valve=90 deg)
poses: valve=0 deg (open): assembly solve converged, state well, 0 dof
valve=90 deg (closed): assembly solve converged, state well, 0 dof
not_verified: No pressure/temperature rating, Cv/flow, operating torque or mass computed or claimed
Threads are grooves, not helical/tapered NPT; body-insert thread is a plain spigot in a bore
Seat preload and packing compression not modelled (small gaps instead)
Handle stop is geometric only; the revolute mate has no angle limit
